content.title: Satellite Maker York Space Systems Looks to Capitalize on Trump’s Golden Dome in IPO
content.summary: Defense companies hope President Donald Trump’s Golden Dome missile defense plan will lead to massive piles of cash for them. Now another start-up, York Space Systems, is looking to profit from Wall Street’s fascination with the Golden Dome. York went public Thursday.
